kpis.description: Pourcentage des ventes nettes attribuées à Samsung
kpis.signal: Premier client du groupe : 11 % des ventes en 2025 contre 12 % en 2024 et en 2023.
kpis.explanation: Net sales to Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd accounted for 11 %, 12 %, and 12 % of total net sales for each of the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

kpis.explanation: net sales to Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC) accounted for 8 %, 7 %, and 6 % of total net sales for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
